payload.title: Write machine code as hex and run it
payload.description:
As the student, I want my first programs to be raw machine-code words that I can run.

Feature: Machine code
  Scenario: Run hex words
    Given three hex words that load a value and exit with it
    When I run them
    Then the program exits with that value
  Scenario: A bad word is reported
    Given a line that is not valid hex
    Then the editor marks it
